messages:
jordan: Quick report from the onboarding demo today: when you rapidly kill the JS sample (ctrl+c or close tab) we sometimes get mangled JSON in the UI from streaming SSE responses. Repro steps below.
priya: Thanks — can you paste the minimal repro and logs?
jordan: Steps: run sampleapp dev, start a long-running text stream, wait ~1-2s after tokens start, then ctrl+c. Browser console or node logs show a partial event pushed through.
```
[info] stream open
[debug] recv: data: {\"id\":1,\"chunk\":\" He\"
[debug] SIGINT
[debug] socket flush -> \"llo\"\n[error] JSON.parse failed: Unexpected end of JSON input
```
jordan: On the JS sample we saw a console stack, on Python sample the app printed \"truncated token\" and exited non-zero.
lee: I ran a quick bisect in the stream-parser: we assume SSE events are newline-delimited but the client shutdown path calls the parser.finalize() which concatenates leftover bytes and emits them immediately without verifying a trailing \n\n. That explains the half-object emission.
priya: Is this tied to auth refresh retry behavior? We have cases where auth refresh triggers a quick reconnect which may interleave with user abort.
jordan: Good call. In one trace the auth refresh started a background reconnect, server emitted a final event, client aborted, reconnect replay logic pushed the same partial chunk again -> duplicate partials in UI.
lee: Proposed fixes: 1) Parser: don't emit on finalize unless the buffer contains a full event (endsWith('\n\n') or matches /\ndata: / + delimiter). If not full, drop and log at debug level. 2) JS/Python sampleapps: on SIGINT/beforeunload, call a graceful shutdown helper that waits up to 150ms for an in-flight event to complete, then force-close. 3) Document recommended demo settings so all SDK sampleapps use the same behavior.
priya: Agree. We should also add a non-strict demo mode env var so instructor demos don't crash during interruptions: DEMO_STRICT_PARSING=false.
lee: I'll add parser unit tests that simulate: mid-chunk SIGINT, auth refresh mid-token, and reconnect replaying buffered fragments.
jordan: I'll open two tiny PRs: 1) sampleapps change (js/python) with the graceful shutdown wait and the env var. 2) stream-parser change + tests. Will include a short bash repro script:
```
# repro.sh
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost:8000/stream | sed -u 's/^/RECV: /' &
PID=$!
sleep 0.6
kill -INT $PID
```
priya: Nice. For user-facing mitigation, sampleapps should catch JSON.parse errors from streams and render a friendly message like \"Stream ended early: partial output omitted\" rather than crashing.
ops-bot: rollout note: prod runtime still on v1.3.2; can merge sampleapp and parser fixes into main, recommend a quick canary.
lee: Small implementation detail: rather than waiting a fixed 150ms we can poll the parser state for an 'inFlightEvent' flag to avoid arbitrary sleeps. But for demo simplicity 150ms is fine.
jordan: I'll implement poll-with-timeout in JS sample and a similar SIGTERM handler in python. PRs incoming, tagging @priya for review.
dev-bot: created issue #3421: \"streaming: handle mid-chunk client shutdown to avoid partial JSON emissions\" and linked this thread.
priya: Thanks — this should reduce noisy onboarding tickets. Once PRs land let's update the devex onboarding doc with a short note and the repro script.
